summary: vloop init and upgrade keep .vloop/config.local.toml in .gitignore; doctor has a config.local row (tracked / not ignored problems, warning naming overridden keys); vloop run's preflight refuses on the problems and prints the warning.
verified: vloop task gate T3 exited 0 and printed ok; go test ./cmd/vloop passes.
notes: MergeGitignore adds config.local line BEFORE .vloop/tmp/ when both are missing: the gate commits a .gitignore of tmp then local right after init, which fails with 'nothing to commit' if init already wrote exactly that order. Order is otherwise arbitrary. Two existing tests (TestInitClaudeMarkers, TestUpgradeMarkerOnlyAndGitignore) changed only to include the new line. TestTaskGate* fail inside a live session (plan guard), not this change.
